title: Chile · Carretera Austral Northern Stage
slogan: A 529 km loop out of Hornopirén ferry
story: Remote Patagonia, ferries and a route that demands planning. On the way it passes Pumalín forest, Chaitén overnight and Futaleufú river roads. The highest point is about 1,000 m. Back roads rather than main roads, where the map allows. The plan has 1 fuel stop marked.

sections.advice: Use Puerto Montt start → Hornopirén ferry gate as clean positioning. Keep it tidy, ignore impatient traffic and save the enthusiasm for the good road ahead. The value here is not drama; it is arriving at the riding section with space, fuel and concentration intact.

sections.advice: This Pumalín forest → Chaitén overnight stretch is for rhythm and scenery. Keep your head up, let the view breathe, and resist turning every open bend into a target. Stop once properly rather than half-stopping everywhere.

scenicChapters.title: Carretera Austral
scenicChapters.narrative: Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast. For 37 km this is Carretera Austral, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it.
